'''Tox Don''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Don, Farr, and aide [[Pa Dua/Legends|Pa Dua]] were present inside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] called for [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] to be given to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in repsonse to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that followed, Don continued serving Farr.

==Biography==
Tox Don was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] who assisted [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the corrupt [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|onacondafarr|Farr, Onaconda}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]],<ref name="DB" /> in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Don held their position during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>

In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Don, their fellow aide [[Pa Dua/Legends|Pa Dua]], and Farr<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> were present on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], inside the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The three Rodians were stood in a [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] while [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] motioned that [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] be given to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in response to the Separatist Crisis. After Palpatine accepted and stated he would relinquish the power when the crisis was over, Don and the other Rodians clapped. The Supreme Chancellor then proclaimed his first act would be the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Not long afterwards, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] emerged.<ref name="AOTC" /> Don continued to serve Farr during the war.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
The aide had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin.<ref name="AOTC" /> "Tox" and "Don" were [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] Rodian names translating to "quick-witted" and "mysterious," respectively.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tox Don first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which premiered on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> In a scene cut from the final film, Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] makes a speech decrying the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] at the Senate Building, to which Don and their Rodian colleagues clap for whilst on a repulsorpod.<ref name="Deleted">{{Film|II}} &ndash; Deleted Scene: Padme Addresses the Senate</ref> The name "Tox Don" was first used in an Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]], accessible through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> The text commentary did not specify which Rodian was Tox Don.<ref name="Depth" />
